round: V38: stage-3 progress bias (V37 "mass" key) trained by TD and tested on cycle-rule first-6144 positions
status: frozen before the pool, any training and any evaluation of this round
motivation: V37: a 41-value bias keyed by the total value of cards >= 192 (one 6144 removed) lowered the stage-3 fit error by 6.2% beyond a global constant (z=15.9). V38 asks whether it raises P(12288 | first 6144) for the website search under the official bonus cycle.
model: training/v38-progress/model5p.h: W31 (V31 float32) plus bias[massKey(b)] added to stage-3 values; bias file 41 float32. Zero bias equals W31 exactly: parity on 320 V25 states with V35 cycle states, 0 mismatches (bin/parity).

pool.tool: training/v38-progress/pool.cpp (W31, cycle rule, cycle-aware website search 5/0.01/clamp, stop at first 6144, full state incl. hidden bonus slot)
pool.selection: states of games not over at their first 6144, sorted by seed, first 2048; if fewer, the round stops and a new block is added by an amendment before any training result is seen

training.tool: training/v38-progress/train.cpp (V32 trainer under the cycle rule; stage 3 only; complete 3-ply cycle-aware strong player, clamped; TD(lambda=.5) five-step return; rates .001/.0005/.00025 stepping at 50%/85% of the wall budget)
training.starts: training/v27-stage3/pools/train-onpolicy.txt (old-rule stage-3 positions; each episode gets a fresh consistent cycle state)

P.what: joint: four-cell table, residual and bias (bias starts at 0, so the start equals W31)

C.what: control: the same joint training without the bias
C.concurrency: runs at the same time as P

B.what: bias only: tables and residual fixed at W31

training.note: Hogwild training is not bit-reproducible; wall-clock budgets mean a paused machine trains less (P and C pause together).

evaluation.search: cycle-aware website search (depth 5, cutoff 0.01, clamp) to 12288 or death
evaluation.freeze: freeze.py records pool and model hashes before any evaluation game; P/C stages 0-2 and B tables must equal W31

primary.E1: B vs W31: reach 12288, two-sided exact McNemar
primary.E2: P vs C: reach 12288, exact McNemar

multiplicity: Holm over E1 and E2, alpha 0.05
secondary: score gained after 6144 (paired normal approximation), P vs W31, C vs W31, P vs B, Wilson intervals, CPU ms per move
adoption: A significant positive primary makes that arm a web candidate (bias: 41 floats in JS); the web release then needs its own checks. If neither primary is significant, the progress bias is not adopted.
